vendor_readme_evidence.matrix_schema: First row contains numeric asset IDs; first column contains dates. Verify the date vector in ALL six files, not only close_cmc.csv.
vendor_readme_evidence.volume_definition: Publisher reader explicitly describes volume_cmc as volume in dollars.
not_proven: Presence of the six real CMC CSVs
Historical Bybit listing or lot constraints

stage_boundary.permitted_intake_result: Source inventory, metadata, identity crosswalk and provenance gaps; not numerical financial scoring.
stage_boundary.historical_reuse_classification: Previously inspected prices remain inspected historical development; new features do not turn them into virgin OOS.

assertions: Resolve product and economic-asset identity BEFORE opening or acquiring a price-bearing payload.
If an affected entity intersects [start_inclusive_ms,end_exclusive_ms), reject acquisition, loading, aggregation, feature calculation, labels and scoring.
Do not use unbounded latest ticker/quote/listings endpoints during metadata intake.
Unknown asset identity or unknown payload coverage is not permission to bypass this preflight.
A metadata-only instruments or ID-map response is not permission to fetch its current prices.
No tokens, credentials, authorization headers or account secrets in manifests.
Hash immutable raw bytes and preserve the raw-to-normalized transform/version chain.
HTTP success plus provider-level success must both pass; HTML/403/error JSON must not be parsed as data.
A current acquisition timestamp or server processing timestamp is not the original publication time of a historical observation.
Unknown vintage remains explicit; do not backdate available_at to a bar close or a fabricated ingestion time.
CMC numeric ID is the primary vendor identity; ticker/name equality is not an identity join.
Require Bybit category=spot and the reviewed quote currency; do not merge a same-named derivative instrument.
Crosswalk intervals must be nonoverlapping and cover the observation/execution time without ambiguous aliases.
Rebrands, contract migrations, wrapped assets, symbol reuse and redenominations need explicit effective-dated identity and unit evidence.
Keep symbolId when supplied but do not infer undocumented permanent Spot identity semantics from a derivatives example.
Current active/inactive/untracked ID maps aid identity discovery; they do not prove historical tradability or historical universe membership.
Include dead/delisted/renamed assets in the source inventory; never derive old cohorts solely from today's online pairs or largest survivors.
CMC date_added/first_historical_data/last_historical_data describe CMC records, not Bybit trading start/end or source publication vintages.
A current instrument response proves current metadata at its observation time; historical status/constraints need dated evidence.
Freeze stablecoin classification as known at the decision, rather than applying today's tags retrospectively.
Require cap currency and definition, including circulating versus fully diluted capitalization; do not replace historical cap with today's value.
Preserve unavailable observations and explicit reasons; no global future-completeness intersection, survivor renormalization or automatic missing-asset substitution.
Use explicit start/end intervals. Convert a documented candle start timestamp to its close boundary; do not reinterpret it as a close.
Daily inputs must follow the contiguous UTC-midnight close grid; sort and deduplicate provider pages, preserving gap reasons.
Only fully closed bars and source information available by the snapshot decision may enter that snapshot.
Freeze whether features use global CMC OHLCV or Bybit-local Spot OHLCV. A change is a disclosed derivative, not numerical replication.
Declare base-quantity volume versus quote-notional turnover and USD versus USDT. Do not substitute fields by matching the name volume.
A modeled conservative availability lag can be disclosed as an assumption; it is not proof of an unrevised historical vendor vintage.
Materialize immutable historical feature snapshots independently at their own decision times; later revisions cannot backfill them.
Require 200 consecutive valid daily observations at an eligible endpoint and 52 consecutive fully closed Liu-style calendar feature/label pairs.
Bind each label to ordered asset IDs, its feature-snapshot hash and the next weekly interval; mask unreleased labels only after feature eligibility/ranks are fixed.
Label source may legitimately differ from the feature provider; preserve its separate identity and raw provenance hash.
Training label_end <= current_feature_time <= decision; execution source_event > decision and observed_at >= source_event.
Use Spot schema and evidence for that vintage. Do not copy derivative qtyStep or launchTime into Spot fields.
Do not unconditionally enforce current deprecated minOrderQty. Current Spot minOrderAmt and the selected order-type maximum need their documented semantics.
Specify whether market qty is base quantity or quote value; never rely on a market-buy default.
Document how basePrecision/quotePrecision/tickSize become quantity/amount/price increments; reject unverified translations.
Point-snapshot rules require spec_as_of == execution observation. Any validity interval is an explicit caller policy, not proof the exchange never changed its rules.
Historical lot/fee changes require effective-dated evidence; current rules cannot certify past execution.
Root's frozen cost scenarios remain stress assumptions, not authenticated account fee rates.
Reconcile fees in the actual purchased-asset currency and distinguish gross submitted quantity from net inventory received.
Current generic PaperWallet buy fees are quote-cash deductions; this is valid declared synthetic bookkeeping but not the documented purchased-asset Spot-fee adapter.
Require tested max-order, quantity-unit, fee-currency and partial-fill/cancel behavior before venue feasibility is claimed.
At 500 USDT, every planned delta must pass its own lot/min/max rules atomically; do not discard small holdings or redistribute them to force feasibility.

failure_disposition.unknown_historical_vintage: Keep as retrospective observed-now source; do not certify as contemporaneously known.
failure_disposition.missing_identity_or_historical_rules: Intake incomplete for venue feasibility; not proof the strategy is economically bad or the 500-USDT account impossible.
failure_disposition.current_metadata_only: Current metadata ready; historical universe/lot/cap facts remain unresolved.
failure_disposition.minimum_cross_section: The fixed 25-asset cohort and five assets per quintile are formation requirements, not a newly added minimum trade-count gate.
failure_disposition.next_bounded_action: Locate the six original real CSVs and metadata, record coverage/IDs/vintage first, reconcile the identity crosswalk and historical rule gaps; enable no real-data model route merely because native synthetic tests pass.

primary_documentation.verified_fact: CMC IDs preferred; symbols can collide or change; returned timestamps are UTC.
ID map defaults to active; inactive/untracked options and coverage metadata exist. These are not historical Bybit membership facts.
Current online instrument schema has Spot-specific precision/amount/type-dependent maximum fields; it is not a historical instrument archive.
Explicit category needed to avoid the linear default; returned startTime is a candle start and an unclosed close is a live last trade.
Spot market-buy quantity defaults to value; explicit marketUnit distinguishes base and quote units.
Spot fee unit follows the purchased cryptocurrency; buys reduce received base and sells reduce received quote.
